categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-performance sintered NdFeB (neodymium-iron-boron) permanent magnetic materials, rubber magnets, and other magnetic products. It also provides related technical services. The main product lines include high-performance sintered NdFeB magnets and magnetic components used in automotive, industrial motor, and high-end consumer electronics sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed core technologies covering the entire production process of sintered NdFeB magnets, including alloy preparation, powder metallurgy, molding, sintering, performance testing, machining, grain boundary diffusion, and surface treatment. It has proprietary technologies such as grain boundary doping control, atmosphere control, powder surface modification, magnetic field orientation molding, and green, efficient surface protection coatings. The company also focuses on green remanufacturing technologies for recycling waste NdFeB magnets.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in the automotive industry (notably new energy vehicles), industrial motors, and consumer electronics sectors. The company supplies to well-known domestic and international clients such as German automotive suppliers (ZF, Schaeffler), BYD, Chinese CRRC, Siemens, and Japanese companies like Makita and Panasonic. The products are widely used in automotive EPS systems, new energy vehicle drive motors, energy-saving motors, robotics, wind power, 3C electronics, and 5G communication equipment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Hefei, Baotou, and Ningguo, and has established sales and service offices in Shanghai, Shenzhen, Germany, and Japan. Overseas sales are supported through direct sales and distributors, targeting international markets including Europe, Japan, and the US.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the rare earth permanent magnet supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of high-performance sintered NdFeB magnets. It secures upstream raw materials through joint ventures and equity stakes in rare earth alloy suppliers, ensuring stable supply of key rare earth metals like praseodymium, neodymium, dysprosium, and terbium.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing high-performance sintered NdFeB magnet technologies with emphasis on low or no heavy rare earth content, improving magnetic performance and thermal stability, and developing green surface protection and recycling technologies. The company invests heavily in R&D, operating national key laboratories and innovation platforms, and undertakes numerous national and provincial research projects. Future R&D focuses on new alloy compositions, grain boundary diffusion techniques, and expanding applications in emerging fields like humanoid robots and low-altitude aircraft.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of permanent magnets and magnetic components. The company employs a direct sales model predominantly, supplemented by distributor sales especially for overseas markets. It also earns income from technical services and licensing related to its proprietary technologies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic manufacturer of high-performance sintered NdFeB magnets in China, recognized for its strong brand and technological capabilities. It holds memberships and leadership roles in industry associations and has established stable supply relationships with major automotive and industrial motor manufacturers. The industry is competitive with increasing concentration; the company maintains a competitive edge through innovation, quality, and supply chain integration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.32 billion, a 7.79% decrease from the previous year, mainly due to lower rare earth raw material prices and pricing pressure. It achieved a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 31.87 million, turning profitable from a loss in 2023. Total assets grew by 9.92% to RMB 2.54 billion, while net assets slightly decreased by 2.92% to RMB 1.06 billion. The company’s R&D investment accounted for 5.78% of revenue, reflecting a strong commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced technological capabilities in producing high-performance, high-coercivity, and thermally stable sintered NdFeB magnets with reduced heavy rare earth content, which lowers costs and improves sustainability. Its green surface protection technologies and recycling processes enhance product durability and environmental friendliness. The company’s strong customer service, stable rare earth supply chain, and tailored solutions for key industries like new energy vehicles and robotics differentiate it in the market.
